@tanstack/react-start.message: Server functions need a server, and the native app has none — this works in dev and in an SSR deploy, then fails on iOS and Android. Move the logic to your API and call it over the network, or use a route `loader`, which is isomorphic. See docs/design/rendering.md §2.

patterns.message: This module carries server functions or server-only APIs (getRequest, setCookie, server RPC, …), and the native app has no server — it works in dev and in an SSR deploy, then fails on iOS and Android. Move the logic to your API and call it over the network, or use a route `loader`, which is isomorphic. See docs/design/rendering.md §2.
